result.topic_en: Upper and lower bounds for the weighted divisor-function sums $\sum_{m\le n} m^s\sigma_r(m)$ in terms of zeta values, and bounds for the difference $n^\alpha\sum m^{s-\alpha}\sigma_r(m)-\sum m^s\sigma_r(m)$.
result.transcription:
Add ms a 94 18 (5) (5)

$1^s\sigma_r(1)+2^s\sigma_r(2)+3^s\sigma_r(3)+\cdots+n^s\sigma_r(n)$
lies between
$[-\tfrac{1}{2}-]\zeta(-s)\zeta(-r-s)+\frac{n^{1+s}}{1+s}\zeta(1-r)+\frac{n^{1+r+s}}{1+r+s}\zeta(1+r)$
$+\tfrac12 n^s\zeta(-r)+\tfrac12 n^{r+s}\zeta(r)+\frac{n^{s+\frac{r+1}{2}}}{1-r^2}$
and
$\zeta(-s)\zeta(-r-s)+\frac{n^{1+s}}{1+s}\zeta(1-r)+\frac{n^{1+r+s}}{1+r+s}\zeta(1+r)$
$+\tfrac12 n^s\{2\zeta(1-r)-\zeta(-r)\}+\tfrac12 n^{r+s}\{2\zeta(1+r)-\zeta(r)\}-\frac{n^{s+\frac{r+1}{2}}}{1-r^2}.$

$n^\alpha\{1^{s-\alpha}\sigma_r(1)+2^{s-\alpha}\sigma_r(2)+3^{s-\alpha}\sigma_r(3)+\cdots+n^{s-\alpha}\sigma_r(n)\}$
$-\{1^s\sigma_r(1)+2^s\sigma_r(2)+3^s\sigma_r(3)+\cdots+n^s\sigma_r(n)\}$
$=n^\alpha\zeta(\alpha-s)\zeta(\alpha-r-s)-\zeta(-s)\zeta(-r-s)+\frac{\alpha n^{1+s}}{(1+s)(1-\alpha+s)}\zeta(1-r)+\frac{\alpha n^{1+r+s}\zeta(1+r)}{(1+r+s)(1-\alpha+r+s)}$
$-\frac{\alpha}{2}n^{s-1}\sum_1^t(\tfrac16-\varepsilon_m+\varepsilon_m^2)(m^{r+1}+\frac{n^r}{m^{r-1}})+O\{\quad\}$
which lies between
$n^\alpha\zeta(\alpha-s)\zeta(\alpha-r-s)-\zeta(-s)\zeta(-r-s)+\frac{\alpha n^{1+s}\zeta(1-r)}{(1+s)(1-\alpha+s)}+\frac{\alpha n^{1+r+s}\zeta(1+r)}{(1+r+s)(1-\alpha+r+s)}$
$-\frac{\alpha}{12}n^{s-1}\zeta(-r-1)-\frac{\alpha}{12}n^{r+s-1}\zeta(r-1)-\frac{\alpha n^{s+\frac r2}}{3(4-r^2)}$
and
$n^\alpha\zeta(\alpha-s)\zeta(\alpha-r-s)-\zeta(-s)\zeta(-r-s)+\frac{\alpha n^{1+s}\zeta(1-r)}{(1+s)(1-\alpha+s)}+\frac{\alpha n^{1+r+s}\zeta(1+r)}{(1+r+s)(1-\alpha+r+s)}$
$-\frac{\alpha}{24}n^{s-1}\{3(1-2^{r-1})\zeta(1-r)-\zeta(-r-1)\}$
$-\frac{\alpha}{24}n^{r+s-1}\{3(1-\frac{1}{2^{r+1}})\zeta(1+r)-\zeta(r-1)\}+\frac{\alpha n^{s+\frac r2}}{6(4-r^2)}$

methods.what: Two-sided bounds for the weighted divisor sum $\sum_{m\le n} m^s\sigma_r(m)$ in terms of zeta values
Asymptotic formula for the difference $n^\alpha\sum m^{s-\alpha}\sigma_r(m)-\sum m^s\sigma_r(m)$, with a correction sum involving fractional parts $\varepsilon_m$
Two-sided bounds for that difference, obtained by bounding the $\varepsilon_m$ sum

items.english: The sum of $m^s\sigma_r(m)$ for $m$ up to $n$ lies between the two stated expressions.
The difference expression lies between the two stated bounds.
